name: Kinja Run On the Wall
description: The Kinja King is a brave soul who ventured into a path full of Ghost. This world's first runner and shoot-em-up game requires you to run and dodge Stone. Ghosts are a common enemy in video games, but in this case, they pose a serious threat to our Kinja King. Our brave hero will need to use all their agility and quick reflexes to run and dodge the stones that the ghosts are throwing.
